newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadians break record for overseas trips in April.
newsitem.headline: Canadians break record for overseas trips in April.

text.p: Canadians made an unprecedented number of trips overseas in April, Statistics Canada said on Monday.

Canadians made a total of 340,000 overnight trips to countries other than the United States in April, up 2.4 percent from March, the federal agency said. The upward trend in Canadians' overseas trips started in early 1991, but the growth has accelerated recently, StatsCan said.

The United States remained the most popular destination for Canadians, however. In April, Canadians made 1.29 million overnight trips to the United States, up 2.6 percent from March at seasonally adjusted rates.
Overall, Canadians made 1.6 million overnight trips abroad in April, up 2.5 percent from March, StatsCan said.
American visitors to Canada took 4.9 percent more overnight trips to Canada in April compared to March, or 1.14 million trips, the federal agency said.
But overnight visits from tourists from countries other than the United States were down, falling 1.6 percent from March to 392,000 trips, StatsCan said.
